cases.question: Why did Rashad call the Quran itself wisdom?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad rejects the claim that scripture means Quran while wisdom means Hadith. Quran 17:39 calls the preceding commandments wisdom. The invisible barrier, shields, deafness, and aversion to Quran-alone preaching become criteria for belief in the Hereafter.
